name: New Request form calculates days and previews the balance automatically

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.daycalc@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'New Request' page via the sidebar link (URL /requests/create).
In the 'Leave type' dropdown select 'Annual Leave'.
Set the 'Start date' field to 2026-11-10 and the 'End date' field to 2026-11-12.
Verify the 'Calculated days' field automatically displays the value '3'.
Verify the balance preview box contains the text 'You have 12 day(s) remaining. This request uses 3 day(s), leaving 9.'
